title: Probability bound for small circuits
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $S$, consider the set of Boolean functions on $n$ inputs computable by a well-formed, fan-in-at-most-two acyclic circuit with AND, OR, and NOT gates, whose gates read only earlier vertices and whose output is a circuit vertex. Measure circuit size by the number of inputs plus the number of gates, and require this size to be at most $S$. Under the uniform distribution on all Boolean functions on $n$ inputs, the probability of choosing a function in this set is at most its cardinality multiplied by $2^{-2^n}$.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit has $n$ inputs and gates ordered so each gate reads only earlier vertices
The output is a circuit vertex
Each gate has distinct arguments, and every NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
Circuit size, the number of inputs plus gates, is at most $S$
